newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian net foreign reserves $8.126 bln Oct 4.
newsitem.headline: Colombian net foreign reserves $8.126 bln Oct 4.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves stood at $8.126 billion as of October 4, the latest period for which official figures are available, the central bank said.
The figure marks a $30.4 million increase from the previous week's total of $8.096 billion, the bank said.

Net foreign reserves have dropped $197.9 million or 2.4 percent since the start of the year, however, and central bank records show that the total for October 4 compares with $8.331.5 billion reported on October 6 of last year.
